responsibility: Implements lightweight channel-text utility predicates and whitespace skipping for the ISO I/O stack. It drives IOChan.Look and IOChan.Skip together with CharClass whitespace tests to discard leading spaces, and centralizes the common checks that interpret IOChan.ReadResult values as character-available versus end-of-line/end-of-input states for use by TextIO and numeric parsing modules.
same_name_distinction: This .mod file is the implementation side of TextUtil: unlike the same-stem .def file, it encodes the actual whitespace-skipping loop with IOChan.Look/Skip and defines the predicates in terms of IOChan.ReadResult values.
